about.sum:
Made for and by courageous women
We have heart. Which is stronger than balls.
The word courage comes from the Latin for heart (cor) and old French, meaning full of heart. And that’s where Bare Biology comes from. The heart. Founded by and run by women. Courageous women who deal with all the same stuff as you.
Women, by nature as givers and protectors of life and as a result of our history and society, are courageous every day. Walking home at night in the dark, smiling through intense period pain and heavy bleeding in a meeting room or classroom, standing firm in a doctor’s surgery when we’re being dismissed and told “not to Google stuff”. Although never courageous enough to tell a hairdresser they don’t like the hair cut. Yes, looks lovely thanks (goes away and cries).
It takes a lot of courage to start and run a business
People often ask me “how do you do it”? I have to pull my big-girl pants on everyday and be a role model for my children and my team. Even when I’ve had no sleep (lifelong insomniac) or am a bag of anxiety. But, I absolutely love what we do here and this business I built. They also ask “why did you do it”?

Summary
Sustainability and sourcing: it’s why we’re here
Bare Biology exists because our founder Mel couldn’t find a fish oil she trusted enough to give to her family. Sustainability, transparency and ethical sourcing have shaped everything we’ve done since, even our name.
Since day one, we have been sourcing our fish oil range from certified fisheries, holding ourselves to rigorous independent testing standards, and developing the UK’s first MSC Certified marine collagen. Since then, we’ve scrutinised every part of our supply chain, from fish oil and creatine to capsule coatings, pouches and ink. Hands up, we aren’t perfect, but we’re working on it.

legal.sum:
Bare Biology respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy aims to give you information on how we collect and process your personal data through your use of this website and will inform you as to how we look after your personal data and tell you about your privacy rights.
We will process and protect your personal data as set out in this Privacy Policy, so please read it carefully.
This Privacy Policy was last updated on 2nd March 2026. Copies of earlier versions are available on request, please email us at info@barebiology.com.
Who We Are: Controller:
Bare Biology (collectively referred to as “we”, “us” or “our”) is a specialist online retailer of high quality health foods and supplements.
Bare Biology are the controller and are responsible for your personal data, which means that we determine the purposes and ways of the processing of your personal data.

Money-Back Guarantee – Terms & Conditions
At Bare Biology, we believe in the quality of our products and want you to feel confident in trying them. That's why we offer a 30-day Money Back Guarantee on your first purchase if you're not completely satisfied.
Eligibility Criteria
Our Money-Back Guarantee is designed to give customers the confidence to try a Bare Biology product for the first time.
To be eligible:
The guarantee applies to your first purchase of a specific product only.
It covers a genuine first trial of a product and doesn’t apply to multiple units of the same product. For example, if you purchase several packs of the same product, the guarantee does not extend to all unopened packs if you decide after trying one that it isn't right for you.
If you are trying a product for the first time, we recommend purchasing a single pack. This allows you to properly trial the product while remaining eligible for the Money-Back Guarantee if it isn't the right fit.

This Returns Policy explains what we offer our customers for returned products in addition to our customers’ legal rights. Some of these legal rights are also summarised below. For detailed information on legal rights, you can contact Citizens Advice at www.citizensadvice.org.uk or call 0808 223 1133.
Returning a product
Hopefully you won't want to return our products, but if you change your mind, please kindly re-package your return with a note including your name and order number, and send it within 30 days.
We can only process refunds for returned products that arrive in a re-saleable condition. Please help us to ensure you qualify for a full refund by:
✓ checking the safety seal on the product is intact
✓ ensuring the product is well packaged
✓ obtaining proof of postage
We recommend using a trackable service on all returns. We don’t cover postage costs where you have changed your mind about the purchase.
